How much does it cost to develop a short video sharing app in 2023?

Reapmind Innovations / August 2, 2023

If you look back a decade ago entertainment was only limited to televisions and radio. With the Inception of digital mediums, the entire concept of entertainment has been shifted to other devices like mobiles and laptops. In recent years, video-sharing apps have been a rapid prominence all across the world and it has given chance to several entertainment companies to develop apps like Moj and TikTok. Several entertainment companies are churning huge revenue from video-sharing apps. Search businesses are drawing an ever-growing audience count.

Video sharing apps are becoming increasingly popular, and there are several reasons for this. Firstly, they are a great way to share short videos with friends and family. Secondly, they are a great way to entertain yourself and stay up to date with the latest news and events. Finally, they are a great way to promote your business or product.

If you are interested in short video app development, there are a few things you need to consider. First, you need to decide what type of app you would like to create. There are several options available, including a video sharing app for mobile devices, a video sharing app for social media platforms, and most importantly the cost to develop a short video app.

The market size of short video app development

Short video sharing app development is one of the most popular app development fields today. The market for short video-sharing apps is huge and many developers are working on such apps. The market for short video-sharing apps is growing rapidly and the apps are becoming more and more popular. There are many short video-sharing apps available in the market today including the giants of the social media industry. Some of the popular short video-sharing apps include Snapchat, Instagram, and Facebook.

Let’s understand what is short video sharing app?

Short video sharing apps are apps that allow users to share short videos with others. These apps typically allow users to share videos in several ways, including by sharing links to the videos, sending private messages to friends with links to the videos, and posting the videos directly to the apps’ channels.

Short video sharing apps have several advantages over other sharing platforms. For example, they are typically faster and easier to use than other sharing platforms, and they allow users to share videos with a wider range of people than other sharing platforms. Additionally, short video-sharing apps are often more engaging and fun than other sharing platforms.

Must have features in short video sharing app

Video sharing apps like Vimeo and YouTube have become a staple in the smartphone world. They offer users the ability to upload, share, and view videos with ease. However, some features are essential for any short video-sharing app.

First and foremost, the app must have a user interface that is easy to use and navigate. It should also have features that allow users to share videos with friends and family quickly and easily. Additionally, the app should have features that allow users to add tags and comments to their videos, which can help people find and share specific videos.

Major features that you must consider while developing a short video-sharing app are mentioned below:

  • App login: 

When you first sign up for a video-sharing app like YouTube, Instagram, or Facebook, you’ll need to create an account. This process includes entering your username, password, and email address. Once you’ve registered, you can start sharing videos with your friends and followers! When you want to log in to your account, just click the “Sign In” button on the main screen of the app.

You’ll be prompted to enter your username and password. After you’ve logged in, you’ll be able to view your profile, add new videos, and more.

  • Video upload:

Video sharing apps like Instagram, Facebook, and Snapchat allow users to upload videos up to 60 seconds long. However, unlike these apps, video uploads in short video-sharing apps like TikTok are limited to 10 seconds. This limitation may be due to the app’s age or the fact that it is a short video-sharing app.

  • Video capture:

Video capture is a great way to document your activities and share your experiences with others. In a short video-sharing app like Instagram, it’s easy to capture and share videos with friends. To start recording a video, open the app and tap the camera icon in the top left corner. You can also use the buttons on the bottom of the screen to take a photo or start recording a video.

  • Video editing:

Video editing is an important skill to have for any video-sharing app. With the right tools, you can create high-quality videos that will attract viewers. Here are a few tips for video editing in a short video-sharing app:

  • Use a video editor to create a basic video. This will help you to understand the basics of video editing.
  • Use video effects to enhance your videos. This will give them a unique look and feel.
  • Use video transitions to create a smooth transition between scenes.
  • Use voiceover to add narration to your videos.
  • Use music to help enhance your videos.
  • Effects and filters:

Filters are a huge part of any video-sharing app. They can make or break a video and can give your video a unique and personal touch. Effects are also a big part of any video-sharing app. They can add a fun and interesting flair to your videos and can make them stand out from the crowd. Together, filters and effects can make your videos look amazing.

  • Duet videos:

Duet video is a short video-sharing app that lets you create and share videos with your friends. You can record and share videos with up to four people, and you can control who can see your videos and share them. Duet also lets you add effects and music to your videos, and it has a built-in editor to make videos look their best.

  • Like and share:

Video sharing apps are becoming increasingly popular. Some of the most popular ones are YouTube, Instagram, and Facebook. These apps allow users to share short videos with others.

One of the most popular features of these apps is the share and like feature. This allows users to easily share videos with others and give them feedback. This also helps to build a community around the video. Overall, the share and like feature is a great way to build a community around a video and make it more popular.

  • Real-time analytics:

There are a lot of companies that are using real-time analytics to improve the user experience on their platforms. Real-time analytics helps these companies to see what users are doing on their platforms and to make changes to the user interface or the content that is being shown to users in real-time.

One of the most popular real-time analytics platforms is Mixpanel. Mixpanel provides companies with a lot of information about the user experience on their platforms. This information includes things like how many people are using the platform, what type of content is being shared, and how long people are spending on the platform.

  • Push notifications:

Push notifications are a great way to keep your followers up to date with the latest content from your channel. They’re a great way to keep your audience engaged and motivated.

In a short video-sharing app, push notifications are a great way to keep your followers up to date with the latest content from your channel. They’re a great way to keep your audience engaged and motivated.

Push notifications can be set to send a notification whenever a new video is uploaded when a video is shared, or when a channel is updated. This way, your followers are always kept up to date with the latest content from your channel.

How much does it cost to build a video-sharing app?

The cost to develop a short video-sharing app depends on various aspects. Hence, it changes based on your app development requirements. The estimated cost to develop a short video-sharing app ranges from $80,000 to $100,000. The mentioned cost is only for developing a basic app with the lowest level of complexity. If you are willing to know the exact cost to develop a short video sharing app then you must consult professionals from top app development companies like Reapminds to get a customized package. A few major aspects that impact the cost of app development are mentioned below:

App development platform:

There are various mobile platforms available in the market but which is your target. You can either choose native app development in which you will be developing an app for a specific mobile platform, such as android or iOS using their respective programming languages. Else, you can choose to develop a cross-platform app that is compatible with the various platform. Native app development is much costlier than cross-platform app development but the native app has proven much more efficient in performance. 

Complexity:

The complexity of the app defines the type of features you are integrating into the app. If you choose to develop an app with basic features then it may range you approx. $80,000-$100,000. But with the increase in the complexity of features the cost to develop a short video app also increases. 

Developers:

The developers working for your business idea are the major source contributing to the cost to develop a short video app. The cost to hire developers varies from location to location and also it is based on their skills and experience. To explain more about the cost to hire app developers, the estimated cost of developers is mentioned below based on their location:

The cost of developers and the time consumed for app development along with other mentioned factors determines the total cost of your app development. An app development procedure may take approx. 500 to 800 hours. 

Conclusion

Short video apps are rapidly gaining popularity worldwide and have been accepted by content developers to showcase their interests and skills. The rapid growth of the entertainment world towards short video creation is tempting most media and entertainment companies to get hitched with the mobile app development companies to develop the best short video app. The average cost to develop a short video-sharing app ranges from $80,000 to $100,000. But the cost of development may vary based on your requirements. 

FAQ’s

How much does it cost to develop a short video-sharing app?

An average cost to develop a short video-sharing app with basic functionalities ranges from $80,000 to $100,000. This is only an average cost, to know the exact cost of app development you must consult an app development company like Reapminds.

Which is the best platform for developing a short video-sharing app?

The selection of the platform completely depends on your budget and required efficiency. If you require an app with the highest performance regardless of the budget to develop the app, then you must choose native app development. But if you are willing to cover all the possible mobile platforms with the least possible budget then you must choose cross-platform app development because it will allow you to code an app only once and use it for various mobile platforms.
